attributes.action: Ban on Fireworks Being Sold to the General Public.
attributes.additional_details:
There’s a serious concern for public and animal welfare with Fireworks being sold to the general public. 

For weeks around Bonfire night people let them off recklessly and without a care to others or their beloved pets. 

I feel there needs to be stronger regulations/restrictions on public use and public sale and for events to be planned in advance with enough notice for people to arrange precautions they need to keep themselves and their animals safe.
attributes.background:
Ban sales of Fireworks to the General Public to help protect people, animals and communities. 
Allow sales for professional use only.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
